structure.unit: Franchises; Sale and Lease of Certain Municipal Public Property; Public Utilities
Provision of Cable Television Services by Certain Localities

law.catch_line: Limitations on providing cable television services

text.section: Except as provided in this article, a municipality shall not (i) provide a cable television service; or (ii) purchase, lease, construct, maintain, or operate any facility for the purpose of providing a cable television service to one or more subscribers.

For purposes of this article, a municipality provides a cable television service if the municipality provides the service:
Directly or indirectly, including through an authority or instrumentality acting on behalf of the municipality or acting for the benefit of the municipality; or
By itself, through a partnership, joint venture, or by contract, resale, or otherwise.
